name: WeniEval-Benchmark-2.0.0-pt-br
description: WeniEval-Benchmark-2.0.0-pt-br is a Portuguese (Brazilian) evaluation suite for conversational and natural language understanding tasks. It aggregates multiple task types common in dialog and conversational NLP (e.g., intent classification, sequence labeling/NER, and question answering) to benchmark models on PT-BR conversational data. The suite is intended to evaluate both single-task and multi-task model performance in Portuguese.
reputation: Increasingly adopted in the Portuguese NLP community as a reference benchmark for conversational understanding in PT-BR.
